commands.label: Discover course chapters
commands.description: Refresh the ordered chapter inventory from the Biology course page.

commands.label: Verify chapter PYQ links
commands.description: Refresh the chapter-to-PYQ document mapping used by batch scraping.

commands.label: Scrape all chapter PYQs
commands.description: Regenerate chapter question JSON and diagram assets for every verified PYQ page.

commands.label: Run benchmark audit
commands.description: Recompute structural, completeness, semantic, and schema-gap audit reports.

commands.label: Rebuild dashboard data
commands.description: Regenerate dashboard-ready snapshots from the latest scraper and audit artifacts.

commands.label: Serve dashboard locally
commands.description: Serve the repo root so the static dashboard and image assets are available in a browser.

workflow: Run chapter discovery when the course inventory changes.
Refresh PYQ links before multi-chapter scraping.
Scrape all verified chapter PYQ pages to update raw chapter JSON and assets.
Run the audit to refresh benchmark risk metrics.
Rebuild dashboard data so the UI reflects the latest artifacts.
Open /dashboard/ in a browser to inspect tracking, questions, and audit drilldowns.
